Task Name: [FT-PLT-01] Session establishment & login
Module: Platform: Shell, Navigation, Personas & Shared UI
Description:
Ensures a Supabase session before rendering; provides a login page (cosmetic in the prototype) and bearer-token authentication for server functions.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PLT-001: The system shall establish an authenticated session before rendering any page.
- FR-PLT-002: The system shall provide a login page with email and password fields that forwards the user to the home page of the active role.
- FR-PLT-003: The system shall require a valid bearer JWT on authenticated server functions and execute their database calls under the caller's token.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PLT-01
Acceptance Criteria:
- No page content renders before a session exists.
- Submitting the login form lands the user on their role's home page.
- Server functions reject requests without a valid bearer JWT.

Task Name: [FT-PLN-01] Annual plans register
Description:
Tabular list of annual plans with spend and indicator progress, status/approval/year/date filters, saved view, export, row navigation and per-plan action menu.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PLN-001: The system shall list annual plans with name, year, budget, spend-from-budget %, indicator achievement %, active status and approval status, with plan number and creation date available as optional columns.
- FR-PLN-002: The system shall filter plans by active status, approval status, year (2021–2031) and creation date range, and persist status/approval/year, hidden columns and page size in the user's saved view.
- FR-PLN-003: The system shall show portfolio KPI cards: number of plans, spend from budget across approved plans (sum-based), and budget-weighted indicator achievement across approved plans.
- FR-PLN-004: The system shall allow exporting the plans table and toggling column visibility, excluding the actions column from exports.
- FR-PLN-005: The system shall provide per-plan actions: view summary (row click, name, eye icon), lock/reopen, increase, decrease, transfer, and «تعديل الخطة والاعتماد» opening the edit session.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PLN-01
Acceptance Criteria:
- All plans are listed with name, year, budget, spend %, indicator %, status and approval.
- Filters for status, approval and year persist per user when the view is saved.
- Portfolio KPIs are computed on approved plans only, sum-based.

Task Name: [FT-PLN-02] Create annual plan
Description:
Dialog to create a plan with name, year, budget, active and approved flags, optionally pre-filled by AI assist.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PLN-006: The system shall create a plan with name, year, budget, active and approved flags, assigning a PLN reference number.
- FR-PLN-007: The system shall validate that plan name and year are provided and budget is a finite number ≥ 0.
- FR-PLN-008: The system shall offer an AI assist that proposes plan name, year and budget from free text, applied to the form only on user action.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PLN-01
- OQ-PLN-05
Acceptance Criteria:
- A plan can be created with name, year and budget ≥ 0.
- New plans default to next year, active and not approved.
- A reference number PLN-… is assigned.

Task Name: [FT-PLN-03] Plan budget lock and reopen
Description:
Lock a plan so no new projects can be approved from its budget, recording the treatment of outstanding obligations and a decision document; reopen when needed.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PLN-009: The system shall lock a plan only after the user chooses the treatment of contracted-not-due and due-not-paid obligations and attaches an evidence file, then set budget_locked = true.
- FR-PLN-010: The system shall reopen a locked plan after confirmation, setting budget_locked = false.
- FR-PLN-011: The system shall indicate each plan's lock state in the register with distinct icons and tooltips.
- FR-PLN-012: The system shall store each lock/reopen decision with actor, timestamp, obligation treatment choices and the uploaded evidence document.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PLN-01
- OQ-PLN-03
Acceptance Criteria:
- Locking requires both obligation choices and an evidence file.
- A locked plan's items are not offered in pickers and project transfer is refused.
- Reopening restores availability.

Task Name: [FT-PLN-04] Hierarchy edit session
Description:
View-by-default hierarchy with an explicit edit mode (?edit=1) where users draft level additions, level edits and plan-header changes (including approval/active flags), preview their effect, and commit all at once with one evidence document.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PLN-013: The system shall provide an explicit edit mode for a plan's hierarchy (search param edit=1) entered from the plan views or the register, and exited by cancel (discarding drafts) or successful save.
- FR-PLN-014: The system shall let users add a root track or a child level to any level as a draft with name and amount, generating code and sort order automatically.
- FR-PLN-015: The system shall let users edit a level's name and amount as a draft, keeping one pending change per level and dropping it when values return to the original.
- FR-PLN-016: The system shall let users edit plan name, year, budget, active and approved flags as a single draft change within the session.
- FR-PLN-017: The system shall recompute all displayed amounts, breakdowns and warnings with drafts applied and highlight changed items and the number of unsaved changes.
- FR-PLN-018: The system shall warn, without blocking, when the sum of a node's children differs from its amount, showing the children sum and the absolute difference.
- FR-PLN-019: The system shall present a save dialog listing all pending changes and require one evidence document when any existing item changes, otherwise stating that no document is needed.
- FR-PLN-020: The system shall persist a session by uploading the evidence, inserting new levels parent-first (mapping temporary ids), updating edited plan/level rows and endowment splits, and writing one plan_edit_history row per changed existing item.
- FR-PLN-021: The system shall reject a session whose endowment splits (edited or for added levels) do not total 100 %.
- FR-PLN-022: The system shall commit an edit session atomically (all changes or none) and remove the evidence on failure.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PLN-06
- OQ-PLN-07
- OQ-PLN-10
- OQ-PLN-16
Acceptance Criteria:
- No change is written until «حفظ الكل».
- Changes to existing items require one evidence document; additions only do not.
- Each changed existing item produces one history row with before/after values.

Task Name: [FT-PLN-07] Budget breakdown engine
Description:
Shared calculation of used, actual available and the five-way split (paid, due, approved/committed, available, pending) per level and per plan, including multi-initiative splits, spend ratios and project progress.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PLN-027: The system shall compute, for every level, used and actual available amounts rolled up over the level and its descendants.
- FR-PLN-028: The system shall compute the five-way split (paid, due, approved, available, pending) per level and per plan from projects, applications and payments.
- FR-PLN-029: The system shall split a project funded by two or more plan allocations into one piece per allocation, prorating its payments by share.
- FR-PLN-030: The system shall compute spend from budget and spend of approved per plan using a single definition reused across screens.
- FR-PLN-031: The system shall render money splits as a stacked bar with paid, due, approved and available figures (full, compact or bare variants), pending shown aside, and negative available highlighted in red.
- FR-PLN-032: The system shall provide a per-project breakdown (contract value, approved-not-due, due, paid) for use on the project page.
- FR-PLN-033: The system shall load plan data in one query set, failing on core tables but degrading secondary tables (history, endowments, shares, fundings, allocations) to empty with a warning.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PLN-11
Acceptance Criteria:

- FR-PLN-047: The system shall require an evidence document (allowed formats, ≤ 10 MB), run an advisory AI check on it, and store it privately before applying the adjustment.
- FR-PLN-050: The system shall apply a transfer by subtracting the amount along the source chain, re-reading levels and adding it along the target chain, leaving the plan budget unchanged.

- Given 1.1 (600,000) and 2.1 (500,000), When I transfer 100,000 from 1.1 to 2.1, Then track 1 decreases and track 2 increases by 100,000 and the plan budget is unchanged.
- Given source equals target, When I execute, Then the error «لا يمكن النقل إلى نفس المستوى» is shown.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-01] Partner self-registration with registry prefill
Description:
A visitor selects the beneficiary type, enters the identifier, and if it is new submits a registration request whose fields are prefilled from the official (NCNP) registry and tagged by source for admin field-by-field verification.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-001: The system shall let a visitor choose a beneficiary type from types that are portal-enabled and not closed for the tenant.
- FR-PTL-002: The system shall look up the entered identifier and classify it as registered, pending registration, or new.
- FR-PTL-003: The system shall prefill registration fields from the official registry when the identifier is found there and label each field as from-registry or edited.
- FR-PTL-004: The system shall capture registration fields (entity name, type, unified number, region, city, classification, official email, phone, delegate name/ID/mobile, bank, IBAN), hiding organisation-only fields for individuals.
- FR-PTL-005: The system shall submit a registration request storing each non-empty field with its value, registry value, source and decision=pending, and show a confirmation.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-01
- OQ-PTL-02
Acceptance Criteria:
- Only portal-enabled, tenant-open entity types are offered.
- A new identifier found in the registry pre-populates fields and labels them 'من السجل'; edited values are labelled 'معدّل عن السجل'.
- Submission is blocked until every non-empty mobile/email field is OTP-verified.
- On submit a pending entity_registrations row is created with per-field source and decision=pending and a confirmation card is shown.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-02] Existing-entity detection, delegate verification and delegate-change request
Description:
If the identifier is already registered, the visitor sees the masked delegates and can verify a relation via an OTP to the delegate, or file a delegate-change request; if a registration is pending, the masked requester is shown.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-006: The system shall show, for a registered identifier, the entity name and its active delegates with masked names and mobiles.
- FR-PTL-007: The system shall allow a visitor to prove relation to a registered entity by entering a one-time code sent to the delegate's mobile.
- FR-PTL-008: The system shall accept a delegate-change request (new delegate name, national ID, mobile, reason) for a registered entity and queue it for admin review.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-03
Acceptance Criteria:
- A registered identifier shows the entity name and delegates with masked name and mobile.
- A pending identifier shows the masked requester name and mobile and offers no form.
- A delegate-change request requires name, national ID, mobile and reason and is stored as a pending entity_registrations row with a note.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-03] OTP verification of mobile and email fields
Description:
Reusable input requiring a one-time code before a mobile or email value is accepted; used in registration and contact edits.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-009: The system shall require a one-time code to verify mobile and email inputs, show a verified badge on success, and reset verification when the value changes.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-04
Acceptance Criteria:
- A code can only be requested when the field has a value.
- An incorrect code shows 'الرمز غير صحيح'; a correct code shows the verified badge.
- Changing the value after verification resets verification.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-04] Applicant context and represented-entity switching
Description:
The portal resolves which entity the user represents (selected membership, else first active membership, else persona.beneficiary_id), shows the user's role in it, and lets multi-entity users switch.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-010: The system shall restrict the portal to the applicant role and show other roles a message to switch persona.
- FR-PTL-011: The system shall resolve the represented entity from the selected membership, else the first active membership (primary first), else the persona's beneficiary, and allow switching when the user has several memberships.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Non-applicant personas see 'هذه البوابة للمتقدمين' instead of portal content.
- A user with more than one active membership sees switch buttons and data refreshes for the chosen entity.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-05] Open opportunity listing with eligibility and quota
Description:
Lists opportunities whose period is open, evaluates eligibility for the represented entity and the per-entity application quota, and separates available from unavailable opportunities with reasons.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-012: The system shall list only opportunities that are active, published and within their open/close window.
- FR-PTL-013: The system shall evaluate each opportunity's eligibility for the represented entity and show the reasons when ineligible.
- FR-PTL-014: The system shall show the number of applications already made versus the per-entity maximum and disable applying when the quota is reached.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-05
Acceptance Criteria:
- Only active, published programs inside open_at..close_at are listed.
- Ineligible cards are dimmed and show the joined reasons; quota-exhausted cards show 'استنفدت عدد الطلبات المسموحة'.
- Unavailable opportunities are grouped in a collapsible 'فرص غير متاحة لك (n)' section.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-06] Opportunity invitation response
Description:
An invited partner opens a tokenised link, sees the opportunity details, activates the entity account if not active, then proceeds to apply or declines; invitation status is tracked (opened/applied/declined).

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-015: The system shall display a tokenised invitation with opportunity kind, ceiling, deadline, duration, description, scope and deliverables and mark it opened on first view.
- FR-PTL-016: The system shall let the invited partner activate an inactive entity account, proceed to the application dialog, or decline the invitation.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-06
Acceptance Criteria:
- Opening a 'sent' invitation marks it 'opened' with opened_at.
- Proceed navigates to /portal?apply=<programId> and opens the application dialog.
- Decline marks the invitation 'declined' with responded_at and shows a thank-you.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-07] Project grant application with dynamic form
Description:
Applicant fills core project data (title, description, amount, duration, region, target groups) plus opportunity-specific fields from the form library and submits; system creates the application at stage 1 with a frozen snapshot and history.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-017: The system shall render the application form for the opportunity using its form-library form (form_id) or, as fallback, legacy program-level fields, ordered by sort_order.
- FR-PTL-018: The system shall capture project title (required), description, requested amount in SAR (required), duration in days, implementation region (list) and target groups with beneficiary counts (repeatable rows).
- FR-PTL-019: The system shall require the applicant to choose an annual-plan initiative for open-track opportunities, otherwise use the opportunity's default plan level.
- FR-PTL-020: The system shall validate required dynamic fields before submission.
- FR-PTL-021: The system shall create the application with status pending, stage 1, stage status received, a submission snapshot, an auto reference number and a 'submit' history entry, and confirm with the reference number.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-07
- OQ-PTL-08
Acceptance Criteria:
- Missing title or amount shows 'أكمل الحقول الإلزامية'.
- Missing required dynamic field shows 'الحقل «…» إلزامي'.
- Open-track opportunities require an initiative.
- Successful submission shows 'تم تقديم الطلب برقم REQ…' and the application appears under 'طلباتي' with status pending, stage 1.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-08] Product request application
Description:
For product-kind opportunities the applicant selects quantities of linked grant products (bounded by available stock); total is computed from unit prices and stored with application_items.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-022: The system shall list the opportunity's linked products with unit price, unit and available quantity and allow entering quantities with live line and grand totals.
- FR-PTL-023: The system shall validate at least one product and quantities not exceeding available stock, set the requested amount to the computed total and store one application item per chosen product.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-09
Acceptance Criteria:
- Submitting with no quantities shows 'اختر منتجاً واحداً على الأقل وحدد الكمية'.
- Quantity above quantity_available is rejected naming the product and available amount.
- requested_amount equals Σ quantity × unit_price and one application_items row is created per chosen product.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-09] RFP offer submission
Description:
For RFP opportunities the applicant sees scope, deliverables, ceiling, duration, activities and payment split, and submits a technical and a financial offer.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-024: The system shall display RFP details (scope, deliverables, ceiling, duration, weighted activities, payment percentages) in the offer dialog.
- FR-PTL-025: The system shall require a technical offer and a financial offer not exceeding the opportunity budget and save them as technical_offer and requested_amount.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Missing technical or financial offer shows 'أكمل العرض الفني والعرض المالي'.
- A financial offer above program budget is rejected with the ceiling shown.
- The application title equals the program title and duration equals rfp_duration_days.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-10] Application attachments at submission
Description:
File-type form fields are uploaded to the private attachments bucket and recorded as stage-1 attachments; file names are kept in answers.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-026: The system shall upload each file selected in a file-type form field to the private attachments storage and register it as a stage-1 attachment of the application.
- FR-PTL-027: The system should collect application attachments through per-requirement multi-file slots with an advisory AI pre-check, consistent with other evidence in the platform.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-10
Acceptance Criteria:
- A required file field without a file blocks submission.
- Each uploaded file has an attachments row with application_id, stage=1, uploaded_by.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-11] AI form assist (describe or attach to prefill)
Description:
Applicant describes the project or attaches a proposal (PDF, text, image); an LLM proposes values for core and dynamic fields and asks up to 4 questions about missing important fields; values are proposals only.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-028: The system shall let the applicant open an AI assist panel, enter a free-text description and/or attach one document (pdf, txt, csv, md, image) to prefill the form.
- FR-PTL-029: The system shall send the field specification and inputs to the LLM and apply only returned values that are non-empty and, for option fields, exactly match an option.
- FR-PTL-030: The system shall display up to four AI follow-up questions about missing important fields and re-run prefill with the applicant's answers or allow skipping.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-11
Acceptance Criteria:
- With neither text nor file, 'اكتب وصفاً أو أرفق مستنداً' is shown.
- Returned values for option fields that are not in the option list are discarded.
- The toast reports the number of filled fields and reminds the user to review them.
- If questions are returned, they are displayed and answers can be sent for another pass or skipped.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-12] Application status tracking and required action
Description:
Each own application card shows title, reference, opportunity, amount, stage label, status pill, 'what is required from you', expected response date and closing reason.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-031: The system shall list the applicant's applications (by represented entity, or by applicant when no entity) with title, reference, opportunity, amount, stage label and status pill.
- FR-PTL-032: The system shall derive and show the action required from the applicant and, when none, an expected response date based on the current stage SLA.
- FR-PTL-033: The system shall show the closing reason for applications that are not pending or approved.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-12
Acceptance Criteria:
- Pending application with no action shows 'لا شيء — طلبك قيد الدراسة' and an expected reply date = stage_entered_at + stage SLA (default 3 days).
- If ETA is past, 'قريباً' is shown.
- Closed/cancelled/awaiting-apology applications show 'السبب: <close_reason>'.
- Empty list shows 'لم تقدّم أي طلب بعد'.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-13] Respond to edit request (resubmit)
Description:
When staff request an edit, the card shows the reviewer note and a 'تم التعديل — إعادة الإرسال' button that returns the stage status to received and logs a resubmit.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-034: The system shall display the reviewer's edit-request note on applications awaiting applicant edits.
- FR-PTL-035: The system shall let the applicant resubmit an application after an edit request, returning it to 'received' in the current stage and logging the resubmission.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-13
Acceptance Criteria:
- Banner appears only when stage_status=needs_edit and status=pending.
- Resubmit sets stage_status=received and adds a 'resubmit' history row.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-14] Accept or object to staff-proposed numeric changes
Description:
Grants staff may propose new amount, duration or product quantities; the partner sees before/after and accepts (values applied) or objects with a mandatory note (proposal cleared).

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-036: The system shall show pending staff-proposed changes with before/after amount and duration, the number of changed product quantities and the staff note.
- FR-PTL-037: The system shall apply proposed changes on acceptance (amount, duration, item quantities) or discard them on objection with a mandatory note, clearing the proposal and logging the response in either case.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-14
Acceptance Criteria:
- Banner lists old (struck) and new amount/duration, count of changed products and staff note.
- Accept applies the values, updates application_items quantities, clears proposed_changes and logs accept_changes.
- Object without a note shows 'اكتب سبب الاعتراض'; with a note it clears the proposal and logs reject_changes with the note.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-15] Contact data self-edit
Description:
Primary delegate edits phone, email, region, governorate and city directly; changed phone/email must be OTP-verified; change is logged in beneficiary_events.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-038: The system shall display the entity's official data (name, type, license no., license expiry, entity number, classification, status, governance) read-only with an explanation that changes go through an update request.
- FR-PTL-039: The system shall let the primary delegate edit phone, email, region, governorate and city, requiring OTP verification for changed phone/email, save directly and log a contact_updated event with before/after.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Only primary delegates see 'تعديل'.
- Saving with an unverified changed phone/email shows 'وثّق الجوال والبريد برمز التحقق قبل الحفظ'.
- Saved changes create a contact_updated event with before/after values.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-16] Bank account update
Description:
Primary delegate updates bank name, IBAN (SA + 22 digits) and optionally an IBAN certificate; any change resets bank verification to pending.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-040: The system shall display the bank name, IBAN, bank verification status and IBAN certificate name on the profile.
- FR-PTL-041: The system shall let the primary delegate update bank name, IBAN (pattern SA + 22 digits) and IBAN certificate (PDF/image), resetting verification to pending on any change and logging events.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-15
Acceptance Criteria:
- IBAN not matching SA[0-9]{22} cannot be submitted.
- Any IBAN/bank change or new certificate sets bank_status=pending and clears verified_at/by.
- iban_changed and/or iban_doc events are logged; toast 'حُفظ — بانتظار توثيق المانح'.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-17] License update with AI auto-verification
Description:
Primary delegate submits official name, license number, expiry and document; AI checks four criteria (number, name, validity, issuer); 100% match auto-applies, otherwise a manual review task is created for the tenant admin.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-042: The system shall let the primary delegate submit a license update (official name, license number, expiry date, license document) and show the status and reviewer note of the latest request.
- FR-PTL-043: The system shall AI-check the license document against the entered values on four equally-weighted criteria (license number, name, validity, issuer) and auto-apply the update only on a 100% match.
- FR-PTL-044: The system shall route non-100% license checks to manual review by creating a review task for a tenant admin due in two days.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-16
Acceptance Criteria:
- Last request date, status and reviewer note are displayed.
- With score 100 the beneficiary record is updated, a license_auto event is logged and status=auto_approved.
- With score <100 status=review and a 'تدقيق تحديث ترخيص' task due in 2 days is assigned to a tenant admin.
- Unsupported file type or AI failure yields score 0 and manual review.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-18] Partner project execution participation
Description:
Partner opens own projects, sees contract, progress, finance breakdown, allocations, co-funding and indicators read-only, and performs partner actions: submit task completion, upload evidence per required-document slot, submit or revise phase reports, read grantor feedback.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-045: The system shall list the represented entity's projects with reference, status and progress and open the project in partner mode.
- FR-PTL-046: The system shall present project contract, finance breakdown, allocations, co-funding and indicators to the partner read-only.
- FR-PTL-047: The system shall let the partner submit a task as completed and upload evidence files per required-document slot when the task is unlocked, its dependencies are approved and it is not yet approved.
- FR-PTL-048: The system shall let the partner submit or revise a phase report when the phase is unlocked and the report is missing or returned.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-17
Acceptance Criteria:
- Only projects whose beneficiary_id equals the represented entity appear under 'مشاريعي'.
- Evidence upload is available only for unlocked tasks whose dependencies are approved and that are not yet approved.
- Partner can submit a phase report when the phase is unlocked and the report is missing or returned.
- Grantor feedback on returned tasks is shown as 'ملاحظات المانح'.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-19] Payment receipt confirmation
Description:
When a payment is awaiting receipt the partner views the transfer notice, uploads the receipt voucher and confirms receipt with an optional voucher number, closing the payment.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-049: The system shall show the partner the bank transfer notice and a receipt-voucher slot for payments awaiting receipt or paid.
- FR-PTL-050: The system shall close a payment as paid when the partner confirms receipt with an uploaded receipt voucher and optional voucher number.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Panel is shown only for payments in awaiting_receipt or paid.
- Receipt upload allowed only in awaiting_receipt.
- Confirm without a receipt file fails (requireSlot); with file, status=paid, receipt_ref and received_at are set.

Task Name: [FT-PTL-20] External AI evaluation report intake API
Description:
Public POST endpoint /api/public/ai-report authenticated by a bearer token through which the client's external grant-evaluation agent writes score, color, label, summary, report, recommendation, per-criterion scores and details onto an application.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PTL-051: The system shall expose POST /api/public/ai-report authenticated by a bearer token compared in constant time against the AI_AGENT_TOKEN secret.
- FR-PTL-052: The system shall validate the report payload: application_id (uuid) or ref_no (≤40) required; score 0–100; color #RRGGBB; label ≤80; summary ≤2000; report ≤100,000; recommendation ≤200; criteria ≤50 items each with optional criterion_id/name, score 0–10, note ≤500; details object.
- FR-PTL-053: The system shall store the agent results on the matched application (external_ai_score, color, label, summary, report, recommendation, criteria, details, external_ai_at=now) overwriting previous values.
- FR-PTL-054: The system should scope agent updates to the caller's tenant, keep a history of each received report and log an application history entry.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PTL-18
- OQ-PTL-19
Acceptance Criteria:
- Without configured token → 503; wrong/missing token → 401 (constant-time compare).
- Invalid body → 400 with flattened zod errors; neither application_id nor ref_no → 400.
- Unknown application → 404; success → 200 {ok:true} and external_ai_at set to now.

Description:

Task Name: [EP-BEN-01] Partner Directory & 360 Profile

Task Name: [FT-BEN-01] Partner directory with KPIs, filters and export
Description:
Tenant-wide list of partner organizations with status KPI cards, type/region/bank filters, free-text search, configurable columns, saved views and XLSX/CSV export.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-BEN-001: The system shall list all partner organizations with columns: name (+license no.), account type, region (+governorate/city), applications count, bank status, entity status, and optional hidden columns account status, NCNP classification, governance score, contact.
- FR-BEN-002: The system shall show KPI cards (total, confirmed, pending, inactive accounts) that act as status filters.
- FR-BEN-003: The system shall filter the directory by account type, region and bank status, show active filters as removable chips, and support free-text search across column values.
- FR-BEN-004: The system shall export the filtered directory (visible columns) to XLSX and CSV and open the partner profile on row click.

**Open questions**
- OQ-BEN-03
Acceptance Criteria:
- KPI cards show total, confirmed, pending and inactive-account counts and filter the list on click.
- Type, region and bank-status filters combine and each shows a removable chip.
- Export produces XLSX/CSV of visible columns of the filtered rows.

Task Name: [FT-BEN-02] Manual partner creation (staff)
Description:
Staff dialog to add a partner organization directly with optional AI-assisted prefill from pasted text or an attached certificate.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-BEN-005: The system shall allow staff to create a partner with name (required), account type, license no., region, city, phone, email, bank name and IBAN.
- FR-BEN-006: The system shall offer AI-assisted prefill of the add-partner form from pasted text or an attached document, without saving automatically.

**Open questions**
- OQ-BEN-02
Acceptance Criteria:
- A partner can be saved with only a name; it appears in the directory immediately.
- AI assist only fills the form; nothing is saved until the user presses حفظ.

Task Name: [FT-BEN-03] Partner 360 profile
Description:
Profile page combining header statuses, KPIs (applications, approved, approved amounts, paid, running projects), commitments chart, projects & payments table, applications table, entity data and bank card.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-BEN-007: The system shall display the partner header (name, account type, account status, entity status, bank status) and KPIs: applications, approved applications, approved amounts, paid amount, running projects.
- FR-BEN-008: The system shall list the partner's projects (as beneficiary or executor) with budget, progress, payment pills and status, and its applications with ref, title, program, amount, stage and status, linking to their detail pages.
- FR-BEN-009: The system shall display entity data: license no., entity number, region, governorate/city, classification group and sub-group, governance score and contact.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Profile shows the 5 KPIs computed from the partner's applications, projects and paid payments.
- Projects include those where the partner is beneficiary or executor.
- Unknown id shows "الجهة غير موجودة".

Task Name: [FT-BEN-04] Entity status decisions
Description:
Staff confirm or block a partner organization; each change is logged with before/after values and actor.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-BEN-010: The system shall allow staff to confirm a partner whose status is not 'confirmed'.
- FR-BEN-011: The system shall allow staff to block a partner whose status is not 'blocked'.
- FR-BEN-012: The system shall require a confirmation and a reason when blocking or unblocking a partner and record the reason in the status event.

**Open questions**
- OQ-BEN-01
- OQ-BEN-03
Acceptance Criteria:
- Confirm is hidden when already confirmed; Block hidden when already blocked.
- Each status change creates a 'status' event with before/after and actor.

Task Name: [FT-BEN-05] Bank account verification
Description:
Staff view bank name, IBAN and IBAN certificate and verify or reject the account (reason required); partner bank changes reset verification.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-BEN-013: The system shall display bank name, IBAN, bank status, last verification (date and verifier) and a link to the IBAN certificate opened via a short-lived signed URL.
- FR-BEN-014: The system shall allow staff to verify a bank account that has an IBAN and is not verified, stamping verification date and verifier and logging 'bank_verified'.
- FR-BEN-015: The system shall allow staff to reject a bank account with a mandatory reason, clearing verification stamps and logging 'bank_rejected' with the reason.
- FR-BEN-016: The system shall reset bank status to 'pending' and clear verification whenever the partner changes IBAN or bank name or uploads a new IBAN certificate, logging 'iban_changed' and/or 'iban_doc'.

**Open questions**
- OQ-BEN-04
Acceptance Criteria:
- Verify is disabled without IBAN or when verified; stamps date and verifier.
- Reject requires a reason and clears verification stamps.
- A partner IBAN/bank change sets status back to 'pending'.

Task Name: [FT-BEN-06] License / official data update review
Description:
Partner license update requests are AI-checked; exact (100%) matches are applied automatically, others create a manual review task and appear on the partner profile for staff approve/reject with side-by-side comparison.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-BEN-017: The system shall AI-check each license update request against the entered name, license no. and expiry, auto-apply it when the score is 100, and otherwise set it to 'review'.
- FR-BEN-018: The system shall create a manual task 'تدقيق تحديث ترخيص: <partner>' due in 2 days, assigned to the tenant's first active admin, for each request sent to review, and link it to the request.
- FR-BEN-019: The system shall show, on the partner profile, every request in 'review' with AI score, summary, document link, a comparison table (current / requested / found in document with match marks) and AI criteria notes.
- FR-BEN-020: The system shall, on approval, apply the requested name, license no. and expiry to the partner, mark the request approved with decider and time, log 'license_approved' with the document, and close the linked task.
- FR-BEN-021: The system shall, on rejection, require a note, mark the request rejected with the note, log 'license_rejected', close the linked task and expose the note to the partner.

**Open questions**
- OQ-BEN-07
Acceptance Criteria:
- Only score 100 auto-approves.
- Requests in 'review' show on the partner profile with current/requested/document values.
- Rejecting requires a note; decisions close the linked task.

Task Name: [FT-BEN-07] Partner audit log (beneficiary_events)
Description:
Append-only log of partner decisions shown as a timeline on the profile, merged with application submissions.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-BEN-022: The system shall record partner events with kind, before value, after value, note, actor and document path, with insert/select-only access.
- FR-BEN-023: The system shall show a profile timeline merging partner events and application submissions, newest first, with Arabic labels, before ← after values (status/bank values translated), reason and actor name.
- FR-BEN-024: The system shall require an actor on every partner event and log team-member additions and deactivations.

**Open questions**
- OQ-BEN-11
Acceptance Criteria:
- Timeline lists events newest first with label, values, reason and actor.
- beneficiary_events accepts only select/insert (no update/delete).

Task Name: [FT-BEN-08] Registration request review & approval
Description:
Admin reviews each registration field (with registry provenance), accepts/rejects individually or in bulk, and finalizes: all accepted creates the partner; any rejection returns the request.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-BEN-025: The system shall list registration requests (newest first) with entity name, license no., date and status (بانتظار التدقيق / معتمد / أعيد للمسجّل), and show an empty-state hint when none exist.
- FR-BEN-026: The system shall show each registration field with value, provenance badge and, for registry-edited fields, the original registry value struck through.
- FR-BEN-027: The system shall let the admin accept or reject each field of a pending request, and accept all pending fields at once, persisting decisions immediately.
- FR-BEN-028: The system shall allow finalizing a request only when no field is pending.
- FR-BEN-029: The system shall, when all fields are accepted, create the partner from field values, mark the request approved with decider/time and link, and log a status event.
- FR-BEN-030: The system shall, when any field is rejected, set the request to 'returned' with a note listing rejected field labels and create no partner.
- FR-BEN-031: The system shall distinguish delegate-change requests from new registrations and, on approval, transfer the primary delegation of the existing partner instead of creating a new partner; it shall also create the primary delegate membership for new registrations.

**Open questions**
- OQ-BEN-05
- OQ-BEN-10
Acceptance Criteria:
- Finalize is disabled while any field is pending.
- Any rejected field returns the request with a note; no partner is created.
- All accepted creates the partner and links it to the request.

Task Name: [FT-BEN-09] Partner account activation invitation
Description:
Staff invite a partner (not yet active) to activate its account using the official verified email; status becomes 'invited'.

- FR-BEN-032: The system shall offer 'دعوة للتفعيل' (or 'إعادة الدعوة' when invited) for partners whose account is not active, from the directory and the profile, prefilled with the invited or official email.

Task Name: [FT-BEN-12] Partner groups

Task Name: [FT-REV-05] Stage Transitions (Approve, Skip, Return)
Description:
Advance an application through its 3-stage workflow, skip a stage when allowed, or return it to the previous stage, honouring per-stage flags.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-015: The system shall, on approval of stage 1 or 2, increment current_stage, set stage_status=received and stage_entered_at=now, and log approve_stage with the from-stage.
- FR-REV-016: The system shall, on approval at stage 3 (final), set status=approved, current_stage=null, stage_status=approved, stage_entered_at=now and store snapshot.approved.
- FR-REV-017: The system shall allow skipping the current stage only when the stage config has allow_skip, applying the same transition as approval and logging action skip (stage 3 skip = final approval).
- FR-REV-018: The system shall return an application to the previous stage (minimum 1) when current_stage>1 and allow_return is not false, logging action return with the from-stage.
- FR-REV-019: The system shall display the stage decision card only to non-applicant personas, only for pending applications whose current stage exists in workflow_stages, with buttons governed by allow_request_edit, allow_close, allow_skip and allow_return.
- FR-REV-020: The system shall let staff add a free-text note to the history at any status.
- FR-REV-071: The system shall enforce server-side that only the stage's supervisors/secretary (or admin/grants manager) can execute stage transitions.
- FR-REV-072: The system shall prevent stage approval while the application awaits applicant edits (needs_edit) or a staff proposal awaits partner acceptance, and apply the pass-score gate inside the workflow library for all entry points.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-01
- OQ-REV-04
- OQ-REV-05
Acceptance Criteria:
- Approving stage 1 or 2 moves the application to the next stage with stage_status «received».
- Approving stage 3 sets status «approved» and current_stage null.
- «إرجاع للسابقة» is hidden at stage 1 and when allow_return=false.

Task Name: [FT-REV-06] Request Edit & Resubmission
Description:
Return an application to the partner for edits with a mandatory note; the partner resubmits from the portal.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-021: The system shall, on «إرجاع للتعديل», require a note, set stage_status=needs_edit and reviewer_note=note without changing status or stage, and log request_edit.
- FR-REV-022: The system shall let the applicant resubmit an application in needs_edit, setting stage_status=received and logging resubmit.
- FR-REV-023: The system shall exclude applications awaiting applicant edits from staff derived tasks.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-04
Acceptance Criteria:
- Confirm is disabled until the note is non-empty.
- After resubmission stage_status returns to «received» and the task reappears.

Task Name: [FT-REV-07] Reject / Close & Reopen
Description:
Reject with a reason from a fixed list and an optional apology message; reopen closed requests back to their stage.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-024: The system shall reject a pending application with a mandatory reason from CLOSE_REASONS and an optional apology message, setting status awaiting_apology when an apology is entered, otherwise closed; stage_status=closed and close_reason stored.
- FR-REV-025: The system shall reopen applications in closed, awaiting_apology or cancelled status to pending at their last stage (or 1) with stage_status received, clearing close_reason and resetting stage_entered_at.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-03
- OQ-REV-15
Acceptance Criteria:
- Reject with apology text → status «awaiting_apology»; without → «closed».
- Reopen sets status pending and clears close_reason.

Task Name: [FT-REV-08] Reviewer Evaluations & Pass-Score Gate
Description:
On criteria-type stages each staff persona records accept/reject with a note (mandatory when contradicting the AI); approval of stage 2 is blocked when the AI score is missing or below the pass score.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-026: The system shall show an evaluation panel on stages with approval_type=criteria where each staff persona records one accept/reject decision with an optional comment (upsert on application_id+reviewer_id; total 100/0) and logs evaluate.
- FR-REV-027: The system shall require a justification comment when a reviewer's decision contradicts the AI recommendation (AI score vs pass score).
- FR-REV-028: The system shall warn when n reviewers decided against the AI recommendation.
- FR-REV-029: The system shall block approval at stage 2 when the stage is criteria-based and the AI score is missing or below the opportunity pass score (default 80).

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-02
Acceptance Criteria:
- A reviewer saving «رفض» while the AI score ≥ pass score without a note gets an error.
- Approve at stage 2 (criteria) with AI score 70 and pass score 80 shows «متوسط التقييم 70.0% أقل من نسبة الاجتياز 80%».

Task Name: [FT-REV-09] External AI Evaluation Report
Description:
Results posted by the client's external grants agent are stored on applications.external_ai_* and shown as a coloured score badge, a «not eligible» flag, a detailed report dialog and a feedback note.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-030: The system shall accept external agent results at POST /api/public/ai-report (Bearer AI_AGENT_TOKEN, timing-safe compare) identifying the application by application_id or ref_no, and store score, colour, label, summary, report, recommendation, criteria and details.
- FR-REV-031: The system shall display the AI score as a badge using the agent-supplied colour and label, and «—» when no score exists.
- FR-REV-032: The system shall show a detailed AI report: conditions (met/unmet/unverifiable, mandatory), strengths, risks, gaps, committee questions, cost per beneficiary (and per day), suggested payment schedule, suggested initiative, suggested track, policy version, per-criterion weight/score/note and the markdown report.
- FR-REV-033: The system shall flag an application «غير مؤهل» when any mandatory AI condition is unmet, without altering the score.
- FR-REV-034: The system shall let staff submit feedback for the AI agent, recorded as a history note prefixed «تغذية راجعة للوكيل».
- FR-REV-035: The system shall evaluate opportunity eligibility rules (checkEligibility) against current partner data on the review page and display reasons.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-10
- OQ-REV-12
Acceptance Criteria:
- POST with valid bearer and ref_no updates the application and returns {ok:true}.
- Any mandatory condition with status unmet shows «غير مؤهل» without altering the score.

Task Name: [FT-REV-10] Compare Applications
Description:
Side-by-side comparison of the current application with another one from the same opportunity, with highlighted gaps and a «نقاط الخلاف للمدير» list.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-036: The system shall let staff choose another application from the same opportunity to compare.
- FR-REV-037: The system shall compare AI score, eligibility, recommendation, amount, duration, region, beneficiaries, cost per beneficiary and each criterion, highlighting and listing disagreements (score gap ≥15, different recommendations, mandatory-fail mismatch, criterion gap ≥3/10, amount ratio ≥2 or ≤0.5, risks on one side only).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Only applications with the same program_id are listed.
- Score gap ≥15 points is listed as a disagreement.

Task Name: [FT-REV-11] Advisory AI Document Checks
Description:
Shared advisory checks: DocAiCheck for official documents (e.g. committee minutes) and FileSlots per-file/per-slot checks stored on attachment_files; never block.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-038: The system shall run an advisory AI check on a selected official document (pdf/png/jpg/jpeg/webp/txt/csv ≤10MB) with action and context, showing verdict, score, summary and issues with a re-check control, never blocking the save.
- FR-REV-039: The system shall provide file slots (one per required document plus «مرفقات أخرى») with multi-file upload ≤10MB, per-file AI check saved to attachment_files.ai_check and optional collective slot check saved to the owner's evidence_ai (activities and payments only).
- FR-REV-040: The system shall warn (confirm dialog) before an action when attached files carry an AI «fail» verdict, and require only the presence of a file for mandatory slots.
Acceptance Criteria:
- A «fail» verdict shows «غير مطابق» but the save/approve button stays enabled.
- Unsupported types show «نوع الملف غير مدعوم للفحص الذكي».

Task Name: [FT-REV-12] Committee Minute Bulk Decision
Description:
Committee secretary selects same-committee/same-stage application tasks, uploads one minute and applies approve/reject/return to all, with per-item results.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-041: The system shall let a committee secretary multi-select pending application tasks only for committee stages where they are the stage secretary, restricted to the same committee and stage as the first selection.
- FR-REV-042: The system shall capture minute number*, minute date* (default today), committee name (prefilled), decision* (approve/reject/return), note (mandatory for reject) and minute file* (pdf/doc/docx/xls/xlsx/png/jpg/jpeg ≤10MB) with an advisory AI check.
- FR-REV-043: The system shall upload the minute once, create one committee_minutes record and apply approveStage/returnStage/closeApplication to each selected application with the minute id and note «محضر <no> — <note>», recording a minute_items row per application (ok or error).
- FR-REV-044: The system shall reject a bulk application decision when selected applications are at different stages, and a reject without note.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-06
Acceptance Criteria:
- Apply is disabled until a minute number and file are provided.
- Every successfully decided application gets a history row with minute_id and a minute_items row ok=true.

Task Name: [FT-REV-13] Staff-Proposed Numeric Changes
Description:
Staff propose new amount/duration (or product quantities); values apply only after the partner accepts in the portal.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-045: The system shall let staff propose a new requested amount and duration (project grants) or new item quantities (product grants, amount = Σ qty × unit price) with a note, stored in applications.proposed_changes with before values, author and timestamp, and logged propose_changes.
- FR-REV-046: The system shall allow only one pending proposal per application and expose the proposal action only from the return-for-edit dialog of pending applications.
- FR-REV-047: The system shall reject a proposal in which no number changed.
- FR-REV-048: The system shall let the partner accept (apply amount, duration, item quantities and clear the proposal) or reject with a note (clear proposal), logging accept_changes or reject_changes.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-04
Acceptance Criteria:
- Submitting with no changed number shows «لم تغيّر أي رقم».
- While a proposal is pending the button is replaced by «تعديل أرقام بانتظار موافقة الجهة».

Task Name: [FT-REV-14] Initiative Relocation
Description:
Staff move an application to a different initiative (plan level) with a mandatory reason recorded in history.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-049: The system shall let staff relocate an application to a different initiative with a mandatory reason, updating plan_level_id and logging relocate.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-09
Acceptance Criteria:
- Saving with the same initiative shows «اختر مبادرة مختلفة».
- A «relocate» history row contains the reason.

Task Name: [FT-REV-15] Merge & Unmerge Applications
Description:
Merge pending/approved requests of the same partner and grant kind into one request (one future contract) restarting at the lowest prior approved stage; unmerge restores originals while the contract is still «preparing».

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-050: The system shall offer as merge candidates only other applications of the same partner, status pending or approved, not transferred, not already merged into another, and of the same grant kind.
- FR-REV-051: The system shall require choosing the target opportunity and/or plan item when the selected requests differ in them.
- FR-REV-052: The system shall build the merged request: amount = sum, BOQ = concatenation with «[ref]» prefixes and new ids, first non-empty payment schedule, merge_parts with each part's prior approved stage, original values and moved row ids; status/stage = approved if all parts were finally approved, otherwise pending at (lowest prior approved stage + 1) with stage_status received.
- FR-REV-053: The system shall close each absorbed request (status closed, merged_into, close_reason «مُدمج ضمن الطلب <ref>»), move its project_indicators, co_fundings and project_plan_allocations to the primary, and log merge on all affected requests.
- FR-REV-054: The system shall require a second explicit confirmation when merging would move a finally approved request back into review.
- FR-REV-055: The system shall list merge parts with a «سبق اعتماده حتى المرحلة n» badge while the merged stage has not passed the part's prior approval.
- FR-REV-056: The system shall unmerge a merged request only when it has no contract or all its contracts are «preparing», deleting its payments, project reports, activities, projects and contracts, returning moved rows and restoring each part's original values with merged_into cleared and transferred=false, logging unmerge.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-07
Acceptance Criteria:
- Merging an approved request with one at stage 2 (prior 1) sets the result to stage 2 after a second confirmation.
- Unmerge is hidden once any contract of the request is past «preparing».

Task Name: [FT-REV-16] Co-funding & Conditional Approval
Description:
Register co-funders (new or existing) with contribution amounts, either confirmed or as approval conditions tied to the current stage; attach donor approval evidence to confirm.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-057: The system shall let staff add a co-funder (pick existing by name or create with optional email) and contribution amount as a confirmed contribution or as an approval condition linked to the current stage.
- FR-REV-058: The system shall let staff attach the donor's approval evidence to a pending co-funding row, marking it confirmed, and open it later via signed URL.
- FR-REV-059: The system shall block final approval (and transfer) while any co-funding approval condition is unconfirmed.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-04
Acceptance Criteria:
- Adding a condition writes a history note «اعتماد مشروط بمساهمة …».
- Attaching evidence switches the row to «موافقة مثبتة».

Task Name: [FT-REV-17] Application Indicator Linking
Description:
Staff link plan indicators (quantitative or milestone) to the application with a required quantity, capped by the indicator's remaining target; links move to the project on transfer.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-060: The system shall let staff link any plan indicator to the application with a required quantity (milestones fixed at 1).
- FR-REV-061: The system shall prevent linking a quantitative indicator beyond its remaining target (target minus all links), disabling exhausted indicators.
- FR-REV-062: The system shall let staff unlink an indicator at application stage and hide the funding & indicators card for closed applications.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Linking more than the remaining target shows «المتبقي من المؤشر … فقط — خفّض العدد المطلوب».
- Milestone indicators link with target 1 and no quantity input.

Task Name: [FT-REV-18] Transfer to Contract & Projects
Description:
Convert an approved project-type application into one contract (status preparing) and one or several projects (BOQ split), seed payments from the payment schedule, move co-funding/allocations/indicators.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-063: The system shall offer «اعتماد العقد وترحيله» for approved, non-transferred, non-product applications, optionally splitting BOQ items (≥2) into several named projects, then navigate to the first project.
- FR-REV-064: The system shall resolve the project manager (explicit → program default → first project_manager persona), contract need (explicit → program has_contract → true) and plan level (explicit → application → program default), and refuse transfer when the plan is budget-locked.
- FR-REV-065: The system shall create one contract (status preparing, amount = requested) when required, and per part a project (status planning, budget = part item sum or requested amount, start today, end = today + duration) and payments from the payment schedule percentages (not for RFP programs, which get the RFP plan seeded).
- FR-REV-066: The system shall move co_fundings, project_plan_allocations and project_indicators of the application to the (first) project, set applications.transferred=true (and plan_level_id) and log transfer with contract/project references.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-08
- OQ-REV-11
Acceptance Criteria:
- Transfer is blocked with «ميزانية «X» مقفلة …» when the plan is budget_locked.
- After success the user lands on the first project page and the application shows the contract card.

Task Name: [FT-REV-19] Product Grant Approval & Delivery
Description:
Final approval of product applications reserves stock and sets fulfillment to pending_delivery; staff record delivery afterwards.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-067: The system shall, on final approval of an application with product lines, decrease each product's quantity_available by the line quantity (floor 0) and set fulfillment_status=pending_delivery.
- FR-REV-068: The system shall let staff record delivery of an approved product application, setting delivered_quantity=quantity for all lines and fulfillment_status=delivered, logging deliver.

**Open questions**
- OQ-REV-07
Acceptance Criteria:
- Final approval reduces grant_products.quantity_available by each line quantity (not below 0).
- Delivery sets every delivered_quantity = quantity and fulfillment «delivered».

Task Name: [FT-REV-20] Decision Snapshots
Description:
Freeze partner and opportunity data at submission and at final approval in applications.snapshot and show them on the partner card.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-REV-069: The system shall freeze a snapshot (timestamp, partner name/account type/licence/region/city/status/bank/IBAN/bank status, opportunity title/pass score/has_contract, requested amount) at submission and at final approval.
- FR-REV-070: The system shall display available snapshots (at submission / at approval) in the partner card.
Acceptance Criteria:
- After final approval snapshot.approved exists with timestamp, partner bank status and pass score.
- Partner card shows «عند التقديم» and «عند الاعتماد» blocks when present.

Task Name: [US-REV-001] As a reviewer I want to search and filter all applications by stage, status, opportunity, kind, region and account type
Description:
As a reviewer I want to search and filter all applications by stage, status, opportunity, kind, region and account type so that I can find the requests that need my attention.

**Requirements**
- FR-REV-001: The system shall list all applications of the tenant with columns project title + reference, partner, stage (+sub-status and late flag), status, AI score, requested amount, opportunity and date added.
- FR-REV-002: The system shall filter the list by free-text (ref/title/partner), stage (1-3), status (incl. «المغلقة (كلها)»), opportunity, grant kind, region and partner account type, showing active extra filters as removable chips.
- FR-REV-003: The system shall show stat cards (total, pending, approved, closed) that act as status filters.

**Dependencies**
- useApplications
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given 10 applications of which 3 are pending, When I click «قيد الانتظار», Then exactly the 3 pending applications are listed.
- Given a pending application in its stage for 5 days, When the list renders, Then its stage cell shows «متأخر».
- Given I type a partner name, When matching, Then rows whose ref, title or partner contain the text remain.

Task Name: [US-REV-002] As a grants manager I want to save my column/filter layout and export the filtered list so that I can reuse my working v
Description:
As a grants manager I want to save my column/filter layout and export the filtered list so that I can reuse my working view and report outside the system.

- FR-REV-004: The system shall let users show/hide columns and save filters and column choices as a personal saved view (key applications.v2).

- PLT saved views

- Given I hide «القيمة» and save, When I return later, Then «القيمة» stays hidden.

Task Name: [US-REV-003] As a reviewer I want to see the full application dossier, partner profile and SLA status on one page so that I can decid
Description:
As a reviewer I want to see the full application dossier, partner profile and SLA status on one page so that I can decide without switching screens.

- FR-REV-006: The system shall display an application header with title, AI badge, ineligible badge, status, reference, opportunity, partner, 3-step stage tracker, current stage name, stage sub-status, SLA progress and requested amount.

- FR-REV-008: The system shall display a partner card with status, bank verification status, running projects (count and budget) and on expansion full profile, previous projects and last grant year.

Task Name: [US-REV-004] As a reviewer I want to open and add supporting files on an application so that evidence collected during review is kept
Description:
As a reviewer I want to open and add supporting files on an application so that evidence collected during review is kept with it.

**Requirements**
- FR-REV-010: The system shall list application attachments with their stage tag and open them via a signed URL valid for 300 seconds.
- FR-REV-011: The system shall allow staff to upload a file (pdf, doc(x), xls(x), ppt(x), jpg, jpeg, png, gif) stored under <application_id>/ in the attachments bucket and recorded with the current stage and uploader.

- Storage bucket attachments

- Given I upload «study.pdf» at stage 2, When the list refreshes, Then «study.pdf» appears tagged «م2».

Task Name: [US-REV-005] As a CEO I want to see who approved each stage, how long it took versus SLA and every action taken so that decisions are
Description:
As a CEO I want to see who approved each stage, how long it took versus SLA and every action taken so that decisions are auditable.

**Requirements**
- FR-REV-012: The system shall append an application_status_history row (status, stage, action, note, changed_by, minute_id) for every workflow action.
- FR-REV-013: The system shall render an approval chain per configured stage showing not started / current sub-status / approved, time taken vs SLA, approver and stage notes.
- FR-REV-014: The system shall show the full operations log (newest first) with action label, stage, note, actor and date.

Task Name: [US-REV-006] As a stage supervisor I want to approve the current stage so that the application moves to the next stage or is finally
Description:
As a stage supervisor I want to approve the current stage so that the application moves to the next stage or is finally approved.

**Requirements**
- FR-REV-015: The system shall, on approval of stage 1 or 2, increment current_stage, set stage_status=received and stage_entered_at=now, and log approve_stage with the from-stage.
- FR-REV-016: The system shall, on approval at stage 3 (final), set status=approved, current_stage=null, stage_status=approved, stage_entered_at=now and store snapshot.approved.
- FR-REV-019: The system shall display the stage decision card only to non-applicant personas, only for pending applications whose current stage exists in workflow_stages, with buttons governed by allow_request_edit, allow_close, allow_skip and allow_return.
- FR-REV-020: The system shall let staff add a free-text note to the history at any status.
- FR-REV-071: The system shall enforce server-side that only the stage's supervisors/secretary (or admin/grants manager) can execute stage transitions.
- FR-REV-072: The system shall prevent stage approval while the application awaits applicant edits (needs_edit) or a staff proposal awaits partner acceptance, and apply the pass-score gate inside the workflow library for all entry points.

- PRG workflow_stages

- Given I am the applicant persona, When I open the page, Then no decision card is shown.

Description:
As a stage supervisor I want to skip a stage (when the engine allows it) or send the application back to the previous stage so that the flow adapts to the case.

- FR-REV-017: The system shall allow skipping the current stage only when the stage config has allow_skip, applying the same transition as approval and logging action skip (stage 3 skip = final approval).
- FR-REV-018: The system shall return an application to the previous stage (minimum 1) when current_stage>1 and allow_return is not false, logging action return with the from-stage.

Task Name: [US-REV-008] As a reviewer I want to return an application to the partner with a note describing required edits so that they can comp

As a reviewer I want to return an application to the partner with a note describing required edits so that they can complete it without rejection.

- FR-REV-021: The system shall, on «إرجاع للتعديل», require a note, set stage_status=needs_edit and reviewer_note=note without changing status or stage, and log request_edit.
- FR-REV-022: The system shall let the applicant resubmit an application in needs_edit, setting stage_status=received and logging resubmit.
- FR-REV-023: The system shall exclude applications awaiting applicant edits from staff derived tasks.

Task Name: [US-REV-009] As a reviewer I want to reject an application with a standard reason and optional apology message so that the closure is
Description:
As a reviewer I want to reject an application with a standard reason and optional apology message so that the closure is documented and communicated.

**Requirements**
- FR-REV-024: The system shall reject a pending application with a mandatory reason from CLOSE_REASONS and an optional apology message, setting status awaiting_apology when an apology is entered, otherwise closed; stage_status=closed and close_reason stored.

Task Name: [US-REV-010] As a grants manager I want to reopen a closed application so that a wrongful or premature closure can be corrected.
Description:
As a grants manager I want to reopen a closed application so that a wrongful or premature closure can be corrected.

**Requirements**
- FR-REV-025: The system shall reopen applications in closed, awaiting_apology or cancelled status to pending at their last stage (or 1) with stage_status received, clearing close_reason and resetting stage_entered_at.

As a reviewer I want to record my accept/reject opinion with a justification so that my assessment is part of the study stage.

- FR-REV-026: The system shall show an evaluation panel on stages with approval_type=criteria where each staff persona records one accept/reject decision with an optional comment (upsert on application_id+reviewer_id; total 100/0) and logs evaluate.

Description:
As a study-stage approver I want the system to stop approval when the evaluation score is missing or below the pass score so that weak applications don't advance by mistake.

**Requirements**
- FR-REV-028: The system shall warn when n reviewers decided against the AI recommendation.

Task Name: [US-REV-018] As a committee secretary I want the minute number, date, committee and signed minute file stored once and linked to ever

Task Name: [US-REV-019] As a reviewer I want to propose adjusted amount, duration or product quantities so that the partner can accept the revis

Task Name: [US-REV-020] As a partner I want to accept or object to the figures proposed by the grant staff so that changes to my request only ap

Task Name: [US-REV-021] As a grants manager I want to relocate an application to a different initiative with a reason so that plan consumption i

Task Name: [US-REV-022] As a grants manager I want to merge several eligible requests of the same partner into one request so that they are cont
Description:
As a grants manager I want to merge several eligible requests of the same partner into one request so that they are contracted once while prior approvals stay visible.

Task Name: [US-REV-023] As a grants manager I want to undo a merge while the contract is still being prepared so that wrongly merged requests re

Task Name: [US-REV-026] As a grants manager I want to approve the contract and transfer an approved application into one or more projects so tha
Description:

Description:

Description:

Task Name: [EP-PRJ-01] Contracting & Project Creation
Description: Bill of quantities and payment schedule, contract approval and transfer of approved applications into one or more projects, contract lifecycle, register and generated contract document.

Task Name: [EP-PRJ-02] Project Portfolio & Initiatives
Description: Portfolio list of grant projects and internal initiatives, initiative creation and the project overview (header, finance, funding split).

Task Name: [EP-PRJ-03] Project Planning & Start of Execution
Description: AI-generated execution plan (phases, tasks, dependencies, evidence, payments), indicator spread over activities and the manual StartExecution gate.

Task Name: [EP-PRJ-04] Execution Monitoring
Description: Partner task completion and evidence, grantor review with AI pre-check, phase reports, milestone approval that releases phase payments, progress and stalled status.

Task Name: [EP-PRJ-05] Plan Revisions
Description: Re-planning of remaining work after start, through project_plan_revisions approved by a person other than the requester.

Task Name: [EP-PRJ-06] Closure & Indicator Achievement
Description: Final evaluation and closure approval, milestone indicator confirmation, quantitative achievement by accepted evidence and roll-up.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-01] BOQ & payment schedule preparation
Description:
AI-proposed bill of quantities (items, qty, unit cost) and payment schedule (title, %, due days) for an application, edited and saved by staff before transfer.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-001: The system shall generate a proposed bill of quantities (4–8 items) and payment schedule (2–4 rows) for an application using AI, from project title, description, requested amount and duration.
- FR-PRJ-002: The system shall allow staff to edit BOQ item title, quantity and unit cost, add and delete items, and edit schedule title, percentage and due days inline, showing line totals and sums.
- FR-PRJ-003: The system shall save the BOQ and schedule to the application only when the rounded item total equals the requested amount and, if schedule rows exist, their percentages total 100%.
- FR-PRJ-004: The system shall make the BOQ and schedule read-only for non-staff users and for transferred applications.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-04
Acceptance Criteria:
- BOQ with total ≠ requested amount cannot be saved.
- Schedule rows must total 100% to save.
- Editing is disabled once the application is transferred.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-02] Contract approval & transfer to project(s) (BOQ split)
Description:
Approve the contract of an approved application and transfer it into one project, or split BOQ items into several projects under one contract.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-005: The system shall offer 'اعتماد العقد وترحيله' on an approved, not yet transferred, non-product application and, on confirmation, create the contract (if required) and the project(s), then navigate to the first project.
- FR-PRJ-006: The system shall allow splitting the BOQ into two or more projects: editable project titles (default = largest item's title), add/remove projects, assign each BOQ item to a project, and show each project's subtotal.
- FR-PRJ-007: The system shall set each created project's budget to the sum of its assigned BOQ items (single project: requested amount) and create its payments from the application payment schedule by percentage (non-RFP programs).
- FR-PRJ-008: The system shall resolve project manager, contract requirement and plan level from transfer options, program defaults and application, and refuse the transfer if the plan level's plan is budget-locked.
- FR-PRJ-009: The system shall move application-stage co-funding, initiative allocations and indicator links to the (first) created project and, for RFP programs, seed activities and payments from the program definition.
- FR-PRJ-010: The system shall mark the application as transferred and log a 'transfer' entry in the application status history with contract and project references.
- FR-PRJ-055: The system shall perform transfer (contract, projects, payments, moved commitments, history) and revision application atomically.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-03
- OQ-PRJ-04
- OQ-PRJ-10
Acceptance Criteria:
- Approved, untransferred, non-product application can be transferred once.
- Split creates N projects with budget = sum of assigned items and one contract.
- Transfer is refused when the plan budget is locked.
- User lands on the (first) created project.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-03] Contract lifecycle & register
Description:
Contract status progression to 'signed' and a register of all contracts with counters and linked projects; contract card on the application.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-011: The system shall create one contract per transferred application (when required) with status 'preparing', amount = requested amount and an auto-generated CON reference.
- FR-PRJ-012: The system shall let staff advance a contract one step along preparing → awaiting_beneficiary → awaiting_signature → signed from the project header, stamping signed_at on 'signed'.
- FR-PRJ-013: The system shall list all contracts newest first with counters per status, contract number, partner, application (link), amount, linked projects (links with budget), status and signed/created date.
- FR-PRJ-014: The system shall show a contract card on a transferred application with contract number (link to register), status, amount and the projects split from it.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-01
- OQ-PRJ-05
- OQ-PRJ-13
Acceptance Criteria:
- Contract moves only forward one step at a time.
- Reaching 'signed' stamps signed_at.
- Register shows counts per status and project links.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-04] Generated contract document
Description:
Printable Arabic grant contract generated live from tenant, partner, application, project and payment data, with e-signature stamp when signed.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-015: The system shall generate a printable contract document from live data: parties (grantor tenant, partner license/region/city), subject (project, program, application number, description), duration, amount, payment table, IBAN, obligations and signature blocks.
- FR-PRJ-016: The system shall show an electronic signature stamp with the signing date on both party blocks when the contract is signed, otherwise 'بانتظار التوقيع'.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-05

- Document shows parties, subject, duration, amount, payment table, obligations and signature blocks.
- Signed contracts show the e-signature stamp with date.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-05] Project portfolio list
Description:
List of grant projects and internal initiatives with source toggle, status counters/filter, configurable columns and export.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-017: The system shall list projects with a source toggle (all/grant/initiative, kept in URL), five clickable status counters, a status-group filter with clear chip, and a table (project+ref link, executing org, value, progress, status; optional source, manager, contract status, duration) supporting column selection, saved view and export.

- OQ-PRJ-07

- Selecting a stat card filters the table.

- Progress reflects weighted activity progress.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-06] Internal initiative creation
Description:
Create an internal initiative (projects.source='initiative') with plan item, department, manager, executor (internal or partner), dates and budget; optional AI form assist.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-019: The system shall let staff create an internal initiative with title*, description, plan item (non-root levels of active plans), executor (internal or partner), department, project manager (default current user), start/end dates and budget*, saved as a project in 'planning'.
- FR-PRJ-020: The system shall offer AI assist on the initiative dialog that proposes values from free text for title, description, budget, dates, plan item, department and executor; values are applied only when the user accepts.
- FR-PRJ-021: The system shall redirect the legacy /initiatives route to /projects?source=initiative.
