Task Name: [FT-PRJ-07] Project overview (header, finance, funding)
Description:
Project header with derived status, contract status, partner, references, links; actual progress meter; value and finance breakdown; read-only initiative allocations and co-funding; partner view of the same page.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-022: The system shall display a project header with title, derived status pill with reason tooltip, contract status pill, partner link, reference, initiative marker, link to the source application, contract document, sibling badge ('مشروع i من N') and staff-only actions.
- FR-PRJ-023: The system shall show actual progress (approved milestones of total), project value with finance breakdown (approved/due/paid), read-only multi-initiative allocations and read-only co-funding, plus duration, manager and plan item.
- FR-PRJ-024: The system shall render the project page for partner users without staff actions (no back link, start, contract advance, plan generation, replan, approvals), while allowing partner task, evidence and report actions.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-01
Acceptance Criteria:
- Status pill shows derived status with reason tooltip.
- Partner sees no staff actions.
- Sibling badge 'مشروع i من N' appears for split contracts.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-08] AI project plan (phases, tasks, dependencies, payments)
Description:
Generate a sequential execution plan with AI from the project, application offer, external agent output and grantor policies: 3–5 weighted phases, 2–4 sub-tasks each with required evidence and due day, optional payment per phase; displayed as a filterable timeline.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-025: The system shall generate an execution plan with AI using project title/description, application offer and answers, external agent output, grantor policies, budget and duration: 3–5 phases with weights summing 100, 2–4 sub-tasks per phase with required evidence and due day, and an optional payment (percent of budget) per phase.
- FR-PRJ-026: The system shall allow regenerating the plan only before execution has started, after user confirmation, deleting existing activities and unpaid phase-linked payments.
- FR-PRJ-027: The system shall enforce sequential phases and task dependencies: each generated phase depends on the previous; only the first incomplete phase is current; later phases are locked with 'تُفتح بعد إتمام «…»'; sub-tasks with unapproved depends_on show 'بعد: …' and cannot be acted on.
- FR-PRJ-028: The system shall present the plan as a vertical timeline with item filters (all/task/report/payment with counts), a toggle between milestone summary and partner task details, unlinked payments at start and retention payments at end, and a closure node.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-04
- OQ-PRJ-08
- OQ-PRJ-14

- Plan generation is refused once execution started.
- Each generated phase depends on the previous one.
- Regeneration asks for confirmation and replaces activities.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-09] Indicator spread over activities
Description:
Distribute each quantitative indicator linked at application stage over plan activities (quantity per activity) during planning, with under/over-distribution warnings.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-029: The system shall show each indicator linked to the project with kind (كمي/كلي), plan item, target, achieved and progress; no new indicator links can be added at project stage.
- FR-PRJ-030: The system shall allow staff, while the project is in planning, to assign a quantity of a quantitative indicator to a non-payment plan activity not yet carrying an indicator, and to remove such an assignment.
- FR-PRJ-031: The system shall warn when the distributed quantity of an indicator is below its target ('يجب توزيع المؤشر كاملاً') or above it ('تجاوز').

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-03
Acceptance Criteria:
- Distribution is editable only in planning.
- Each activity can carry one indicator distribution.
- Under- and over-distribution are flagged.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-10] Start execution gate
Description:
Manual 'اعتماد الخطة وبدء التنفيذ' action moving a project from planning to in_progress when plan, signed contract and full indicator spread exist.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-032: The system shall provide 'اعتماد الخطة وبدء التنفيذ' to staff on planning projects, disabled with a list of blockers unless: the plan has ≥1 non-payment activity; any contract is signed; every quantitative indicator link is distributed exactly to its target. On click the project status becomes in_progress.
- FR-PRJ-033: The system shall lock partner task actions (submit, upload) while the project is in planning.
- FR-PRJ-054: The system shall enforce project, contract, task, report, revision and closure transitions and role permissions server-side (state preconditions, approver ≠ requester, partner ownership).

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-01
- OQ-PRJ-10
Acceptance Criteria:
- Button disabled with listed blockers if any condition fails.
- On success status becomes in_progress.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-11] Task execution & evidence review
Description:
Partner uploads evidence per required slot and submits tasks; grantor reviews with an advisory AI pre-check, accepts evidence, approves, returns with notes or revokes approval.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-034: The system shall let the partner upload multiple files per required evidence slot (parsed from evidence_required, default 'ما يثبت الإنجاز') plus 'other', marking the task evidence as submitted; AI checks run per file.
- FR-PRJ-035: The system shall let the partner mark an open or returned task as completed (task_status=submitted) when the phase is not locked and its dependencies are approved.
- FR-PRJ-036: The system shall let staff approve a submitted task (approved, progress 100), return it with mandatory notes (returned, progress 0, feedback timestamp) or revoke approval of an approved sub-task (back to submitted, progress 0).
- FR-PRJ-037: The system shall show staff an AI pre-check (worst per-file verdict, minimum score, summary and issues) for submitted evidence and allow accepting the evidence (approves task), sending AI notes as-is, or editing notes before sending.
- FR-PRJ-038: The system shall recompute a phase's progress as the average of its sub-tasks' progress whenever a sub-task is updated.
- FR-PRJ-056: The system shall surface project items awaiting action (submitted tasks/evidence, submitted reports, pending revisions for eligible approvers, returned items for the partner) in the task inbox.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-09
- OQ-PRJ-01
Acceptance Criteria:
- Partner cannot act on locked phases or blocked tasks.
- Return requires notes and resets progress.
- Accepting evidence approves the task.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-12] Phase reports & milestone approval
Description:
Partner submits one report per phase; grantor approves/returns it; one-click milestone approval approves the phase and makes its payment due; phase payment stays locked until conditions are met.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-039: The system shall let the partner submit one report per unlocked phase (title 'تقرير: <phase>', body required) and edit/resubmit it when returned.
- FR-PRJ-040: The system shall let staff approve or return a submitted phase report.
- FR-PRJ-041: The system shall let staff approve the current milestone in one click once its report exists: approve all tasks and evidence, set phase progress 100, approve the report and move the phase payment from new/pending to due, after warning about AI-failed files.
- FR-PRJ-042: The system shall keep a phase payment locked ('معلقة' with missing conditions) until all phase tasks are approved, uploaded evidence accepted and the phase report approved, then expose the FIN payment actions.

**Open questions**
- OQ-PRJ-08
Acceptance Criteria:
- Milestone approval unavailable until a report exists.
- After approval the phase payment is 'due'.
- Payment shows 'معلقة' with missing conditions until ready.

Task Name: [FT-PRJ-13] Project status & progress derivation
Description:
Stored lifecycle (planning, in_progress, completed) plus a derived 'stalled' display status for overdue unapproved activities; execution 'started' detection.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-043: The system shall derive the displayed project status: completed/closed and planning as stored; otherwise 'stalled' when any activity is overdue and not approved (with count), else the stored status.

Description:
After execution starts, staff request a re-plan with a reason (and optional evidence); AI proposes changes to remaining work only; another person approves (applied) or rejects with a note; full history with diffs.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-PRJ-045: The system shall let staff request a re-plan of a started project with a mandatory reason (≥5 chars) and optional evidence file, generate an AI proposal for remaining work only, enforce locks, reject proposals whose payments exceed the budget, and preview a diff and new payments total before submitting.

- FR-PRJ-048: The system shall apply an approved revision: re-enforce locks against the current plan, delete unlocked removed tasks/phases/payments, update or insert phases (order, weight, due date = last task date), sub-tasks and payments.

Task Name: [FT-FIN-01] Payment register & status tracking

**Functional requirements**

- FR-FIN-003: The system shall filter the register by payment status and allow the user to save the selected status as a personal view.
- FR-FIN-004: The system shall compute a due band for each unpaid payment: 'متأخرة N يوم' (overdue), 'اليوم', 'خلال N أيام' (≤7), 'خلال N يوم' (≤30) or 'أكثر من شهر'.
- FR-FIN-005: The system shall display who the payment is waiting on, derived from its status and approval step.
- FR-FIN-006: The system shall export the currently filtered payment list to a UTF-8 CSV file named payments.csv.
- FR-FIN-007: The system shall restrict the payment register and its totals to the signed-in user's organization and to roles authorized to view finance data.

**Open questions**
- OQ-FIN-06
- OQ-FIN-11
Acceptance Criteria:
- Register lists every payment ordered by due date with ref, project, partner, title, amount, due date + band, status, waiting-on and action.

Task Name: [FT-FIN-02] Payment preparation (new → due → submitted for approval)

**Functional requirements**

- FR-FIN-009: The system shall allow staff to mark a 'new' payment as due.
- FR-FIN-010: The system shall make a milestone-linked payment due automatically when its project phase is approved, and lock the payment's actions in the project tree until phase tasks, evidence and phase report are approved.
- FR-FIN-011: The system shall allow staff to submit a due payment for approval, setting status awaiting_approval and approval step 0.
- FR-FIN-012: The system shall restrict marking payments due and submitting them for approval to authorized roles and shall apply the same milestone gating on every screen.

**Open questions**

- OQ-FIN-02
Acceptance Criteria:

- A 'due' payment shows 'رفع للاعتماد' and moves to 'awaiting_approval' with approval_step 0.

Task Name: [FT-FIN-03] Multi-level payment approval chain
Description:
Sequential approval by project manager (of that project), grants manager and CEO. Approve advances the step; final approval moves to awaiting transfer and issues the disbursement order; reject returns the payment to 'due' and restarts the chain. Decisions are logged and surfaced as derived tasks.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-FIN-013: The system shall apply a fixed three-step payment approval chain: 1 Project manager, 2 Grants manager, 3 CEO.
- FR-FIN-014: The system shall allow a persona to act on an awaiting-approval payment only if it is admin, or it is the project's manager at step 1, or its role equals the step role at steps 2-3.
- FR-FIN-015: The system shall present an approval dialog showing payment title, amount, due date, approval level 'n of 3 (role)', the AI evidence opinion marked advisory, and—at the final step—a note that the disbursement order will be issued to finance.
- FR-FIN-016: The system shall, on approval, increment the approval step; if the chain is complete it shall set status awaiting_transfer and issue the disbursement order (number and timestamp), otherwise keep status awaiting_approval.
- FR-FIN-017: The system shall, on rejection at any step, return the payment to status 'due' with approval step 0 so the full chain restarts on resubmission.
- FR-FIN-018: The system shall record every approval decision in payment_approvals with payment, 1-based step, approver, decision (approved/rejected), note and optional committee minute.
- FR-FIN-019: The system shall derive a 'payment approval' task for each awaiting-approval payment of the user's organization for which the user is the eligible approver, count them in navigation badges, and allow approve/reject from My Tasks.
- FR-FIN-020: The system shall warn (without blocking) before approving, transferring or confirming receipt when any related payment file or linked milestone evidence was flagged 'fail' by the AI pre-check.
- FR-FIN-021: The system shall allow a committee secretary to approve or reject several payments at once through one committee minute, recording the minute on each decision and a minute item per payment (success or error).
- FR-FIN-022: The system shall enforce approval authority and segregation of duties on the server: the approver must be eligible for the current step and must not have approved an earlier step of the same payment cycle.

**Open questions**
- OQ-FIN-03
- OQ-FIN-04
- OQ-FIN-05
Acceptance Criteria:
- Only the persona matching the current step (or admin) sees the approve button; others see 'بانتظار اعتماد <role>'.
- Approving step 3 of 3 sets status awaiting_transfer and generates a disbursement number DSB-….
- Rejecting at any step sets status 'due' and approval_step 0 and logs a 'rejected' decision.

- OQ-FIN-08

- Print opens the browser print dialog with the order only.

Task Name: [FT-FIN-05] Third-party payee

**Functional requirements**

Task Name: [FT-FIN-06] Bank transfer recording

**Functional requirements**
- FR-FIN-032: The system shall provide, for awaiting-transfer payments, a 'إشعار الحوالة البنكية' file slot that finance and admin can upload to, while other staff see it read-only.
- FR-FIN-033: The system shall confirm a transfer only when at least one transfer-notice file exists, saving the optional transfer reference and transfer timestamp and setting status awaiting_receipt.

Task Name: [FT-FIN-07] Partner receipt & payment closure
Description:
The partner (applicant persona) sees the transfer notice, uploads the receipt voucher (سند القبض), optionally enters its number and confirms receipt, which closes the payment as paid.

- FR-FIN-035: The system shall show the partner persona, only for payments awaiting receipt or paid, the transfer notice (read-only) and a receipt-voucher slot that is uploadable while awaiting receipt.

Task Name: [FT-FIN-08] Money split breakdown (consumer of PLN rules)
Description:
Shared five-way money split (available / pending / approved / due / paid) for plans, plan levels and projects, rendered by FinanceBreakdown, plus the two spend-rate indicators.

**Functional requirements**
- FR-FIN-038: The system shall compute a project's money split from its payments: paid = Σ(awaiting_receipt, paid), due = Σ(due, awaiting_approval, awaiting_transfer), approved = max(0, budget − paid − due); available and pending are 0.
- FR-FIN-039: The system shall compute plan and plan-level money splits: for each project under the level (split per initiative allocation share) add paid/due × share and approved = max(0, budget − (paid+due) × share); add approved-but-not-transferred applications to approved; pending = Σ requested of applications under review (informational); available = total − approved − due − paid.
- FR-FIN-040: The system shall render a money split as a stacked bar (paid green, due amber, approved blue, available grey) with labelled amounts, negative available in red, pending shown aside with a dashed violet marker, and a shared legend for list views.
- FR-FIN-041: The system shall compute spend rates: 'الصرف من الموازنة' = paid ÷ plan budget × 100 (capped at 100) and 'الصرف من المعتمد' = paid ÷ (approved + due + paid) × 100 (capped at 100).

**Open questions**
- OQ-FIN-14
Acceptance Criteria:
- For a project, paid = Σ awaiting_receipt+paid, due = Σ due+awaiting_approval+awaiting_transfer, approved = max(0, budget − paid − due).
- Negative available is shown in red.
- Pending appears separately as 'محجوز مؤقتاً' and never reduces available.
